content: अभ्यञ्जनम् .²1 Smearing the body with oily substances, inunction; भोजनाभ्यञ्जनाद्दानाद्यदन्यत्कुरुते तिलैः <ls>Ms. 10. 91</ls>. .²2 Smearing or anointing in general. .²3 Applying collyrium to the eyelashes; <ls>Ms. 2. 211</ls>. (here the 1 & 2 meaning can be applicable). .²4 An oily substance; oil, unguent. .²5 An ornament, decoration (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²6 Cream of milk; (<ls>Nigh.</ls>).
